patterns.why: the CLI entry the anchor resolves: `--profile web` and the pass-through of `--port`/`--no-open` (src/args.mjs)
runProfile installs installFailLoud, which is why the harness runs in a child process at all (AGENTS.md fact 1)
the readiness line the shell parses out of the child`s stdout (src/url-line.mjs)
the flag surface: `--port <n>` (0 means "let the OS pick") and `--no-open` (src/args.mjs)
the port fallback `ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080`, which must stay nullish for `--port 0` to survive
the webserver schema: `port` must keep accepting 0, or the OS-assigned port silently becomes a fixed one
the auth fence (401 for a clean root, 303 + Set-Cookie for a token URL) and the `dsh-auth-` cookie prefix the shell sweeps (src/main.js)
the fail-loud kill switch, and the rule that a `DSH_*` variable may not come from an environment file (src/paths.mjs)
the GUI`s language rule — exact id, then primary subtag — which the shell`s own resolver mirrors (src/i18n.mjs)
the SSH rule the shell implements by deleting SSH_* from the child`s environment (src/harness.mjs)
the Windows tree-kill precedent the shell copies: `taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F` (src/harness.mjs)
the source of the app`s icon, read at build time by tools/make-icon.mjs
